problems: The blind guess ('abstract outline, possibly a seated animal or bird') does not match the Ram in the Surf, so match is 2/5. Nothing in the drawing clearly reads as a ram.
The gold lines form a sparse stick skeleton, not a silhouette. Horns, crown, withers, back, belly and legs are single straight segments meeting at points, with no body mass.
The horns are two short spikes fanning out from one crown point (63613 upper-left, 57696 upper-right). They do not curl back or sweep out in a recognisable ram shape.
The ram's eye (65468) sits at about (173,230), outside the head, floating in empty space to the left of the head outline.
The body is one vertical gold line from the withers (59151) down to the belly (58484), with the back (58905) on it. There is no torso width, so it reads as a pole.

The legs are unclear. The foreleg star (60000) lies on a diagonal gold line left of the belly, while the hind hoof (52633) sits far right at about (372,397) on a separate line. The four-legged stance is not legible.
The wave stars (69896, 70248, 72370, 70638) form a small gold zigzag at lower left. The surf is not drawn as a wave shape; the blue outline there is a generic horizontal sea line.
Labels collide: the 'crown' label overlaps the 'left horn' label, and the 'foreleg lifted over the wave' label runs across the belly line.
Orientation is correct: horns at the top, legs and surf at the bottom.
output.advice: Redraw as a solid ram silhouette in profile so it reads at a glance. (1) Head: place the ram's eye (65468) inside a head outline just below the crown (61199). (2) Horns: spiral them from the crown. Left horn tip (63613) curls back over the brow; right horn tip (57696) sweeps up and out. Make both clearly curled, not spikes. (3) Torso: draw a closed body outline with withers (59151) on top of the neck, back (58905) along the top edge, belly (58484) along the bottom edge, so the body has width. (4) Legs: give four distinct legs. Foreleg (60000) lifted over the wave, with its hoof meeting wave-top (69896). Hind hoof (52633) planted in the surf near foam (70638). (5) Surf: draw the wave stars (69896, 70248, 72370) as one curling wave crest the foreleg rests on, with foam (70638) beneath the hooves. (6) Move the crown and horn labels apart and keep the foreleg label off the belly line.
